llm_response.reason: The website presents as a luxury womenswear store with branded merchandise ('Veronica Beard'), yet lacks essential legitimacy indicators such as company background, clear contact information, business email/phone, and policy pages—all of which are standard on genuine online shopping sites. Its vague claims of secure shopping, empty cart/account navigation, and no links to privacy or customer service further indicate deception. These are textbook characteristics of fake online shopping scams.
